graph.title: LEGO BrickHeadz 41589 Captain America

new_part_types.name: Plate 1x4 with two end studs (dark blue)

notes: Only one model in the booklet (Captain America); the Iron Man/Black Widow/Hulk pages are adverts.

Fix for the V4 port-reuse errors: every part type now has one numbered stud/anti-stud port per real stud position (and side-stud.N for the studs on the face of the grey bracket 6123809), and each connection uses its own port. Studs are numbered row-major, with row 1 at the back of the model and column 1 at the left. Where two parts touch over several studs I record one edge, or two where it helped to show the span. Not every stud contact is listed.
Element IDs from the inventory page are used as type ids (lego-<ID>). Only lego-302326 (feet) was already in the catalogue.

The 14 grey brackets are modelled as a 1x2 plate on top (stud.1-2), anti-studs below, and four studs on one side face. Plates mounted sideways (arm plates, face plates, back plate, ears) push their anti-studs onto those side studs. The head is two rings of 6 brackets around a 2x2 hollow that holds the orange/white/pink core.
Torso top layer (step 5): the brown 2x4 plate, two L-corner plates and the tan 1x2 plate together make the 4x4 footprint that ring 1 and the orange core sit on.

Step 3 sub-assembly is read from small pictures: brown 1x4 on the back blue brick, two blue 1x1 plates at its ends, the clip plate in the middle, then a brown 1x2 and two more blue 1x1 plates stacked on top. This may not be exact.

Hands are blue 2x2 plates pressed onto the bracket side studs. Each carries a tile 1x2 and a brown clip plate on its own studs. The shield clips onto the left (side-clip) hand. Steps 6-7 are low resolution.

The ear stack (steps 15-18) is only roughly resolved. Its tan and blue tiles and plate are placed on distinct side studs of the left (b30/b40) or right (b31/b41) brackets. The copy-2 attach overrides move each of them to the right side.

Leg order is inferred: the 2x2 plate (b56) sits on the underside of the brown body plate, the blue 1x2 bricks hang from its anti-studs, and the black 1x2 feet go below them. The feet stand on base studs 8 and 11 (the exact base positions are a guess). The name tile, the black 1x4 plate with two studs and the 1x4 tile follow the step 23 inset roughly.

graph_initial.title: LEGO BrickHeadz 41589 Captain America

new_part_types.name: Plate 1x4 with two end studs (dark blue)

notes: Only one model in the booklet (Captain America); the Iron Man/Black Widow/Hulk pages are adverts.

Element IDs from the inventory page are used as type ids (lego-<ID>). Only lego-302326 existed in the catalogue; all other types are new, with simplified single stud.1 / anti-stud.1 ports representing the whole stud or anti-stud set.

Step 3 arm sub-assembly is interpreted as a layered stack: brown 1x4 at the bottom, then two blue 1x1 plates plus the clip plate, then two more blue 1x1 plates plus a brown 1x2 on top. It is placed on the back blue brick. The pictures are ambiguous here.

Hands are modelled as blue 2x2 plates pressed onto the outward-facing bracket faces. The left hand has the shield clipped on (step 21). Step 6 and 7 hand plates are interpreted from low-resolution drawings.

The ear sub-assemblies (steps 15-18) are only roughly resolved. The tan 1x2 plate is joined to the side bracket face and the other tan and blue tiles and the slope are linked to it as a star. Their real stud contacts could not be read from the drawings. The second copy attaches to the right-side bracket (b31) instead of b30.

The two-stud plate 1x4 on the base is assumed to carry the 1x4 tile. The printed name tile is on the 4x6 base plate. Leg and foot placement is on the blue 2x2 plate under the brown torso plate, then the feet stand on base studs.
Ring brackets (b28-b33, b38-b43) positions are inferred: 6 brackets per ring form a 4x4 outline around a 2x2 hollow that holds the orange/white/pink core.
